versions.name: Massawepie Scout Camps - Camp Pioneer
versions.address: 65 Massawepie Rd Tupper Lake, New York 12986

features.note: A campfire circle used for the camp-wide orientation and the two camp-wide campfires.
A BMX area is one of the staffed program areas.
Provided for the convenience of leaders in camp.
A thirty-foot artificial rock wall.
Offered as a challenge program for older Scouts.
Troops choose the dining hall, patrol cooking, or a combination of both.
The Trailblazers program, blending Tenderfoot through First Class advancement with camp orientation and merit badge choices.
Eight ponds on the property.
Staffed by a qualified EMT with a non-resident doctor on call.
A provisional older-Scout high-adventure track alongside the resident program.
Twenty miles of trails on a thirty-seven-hundred-acre property.
An ecology and conservation area.
Fifteen wilderness outposts on the property; trail food for outpost trips is sold at the trek centre.
Units electing patrol cooking get an orientation covering food pick-up, patrol buckets and sanitation.
Each campsite has its own pavilion.
Canvas tents on platforms with cots and mattresses, set up to sleep two.
A sixteen-point rifle range.
A natural rock face alongside the artificial wall.
A two-stand shotgun range.
A staffed tomahawk range.
A full-service post carrying camping supplies, craft kits, merit badge pamphlets and snacks.
A private mile-long lake used for both swimming and boating.
